lifecycle: Adding on server syncs serialized modifier list to all players via registered clientbound tick_rate payload. Client handler enqueues work, checks clientbound flow, clears old list and deserializes the snapshot. Player ID/type is delivery/validity identity, not inferred progression ownership.

Registered ClientProxy Pre tick advances masterTick when running/unpaused with level+player, expires local copies and writes Timer.msPerTick. Server Pre tick calls masterTick only inside the ModifiableTickRateServer instanceof arm. This JAR contains that server mixin and entity tick gate mixin, but citadel.mixins.json does not activate either: configured mixins are BlockBehaviourAccessor, NoiseGeneratorSettingsMixin, LivingEntityMixin; client list empty. No server entity slowdown/clock hook is supplied by these configured Citadel mixins. Conditional helper bodies are retained as such, not claimed active by class presence.

Native enter updates only first matching local entity ID maxDuration; no age reset or sync. Native leave directly removes only last matching local entity ID; no sync. Client copies therefore do not automatically receive those changes. Expiry/dimension removal and native status lifecycle remain original.

obligations.reason: Both native actors delegate supplied motion to ICustomCollisions. Solver combines entity collisions, near world-border collision and loaded block shapes. CustomCollisionsBlockCollisions omits a block shape only when that entity implements ICustomCollisions and its own canPassThrough returns true; native actor filters remain authoritative. Clip Y first, then horizontal axes in magnitude-dependent order. On ground or downward Y clipping with positive maxUpStep and horizontal clipping, compare step alternatives by horizontal distance and apply final Y correction. No direct damage, terrain destruction, status, owner transfer or ignored entity collisions.

Lux canReach reads getPath immediately: null result/path retains its native squared-distance fallback, not proof of an immediately computed/reachable path.
